expected.logged: [Backup] Auto backup skipped — no players online for <server>.

notes: The timer's own guard (line 777) already requires the backend to still be running, stopping the timer otherwise. The no-players guard (line 781) is a SEPARATE check, re-evaluated on every single tick -- a quiet server with autoBackupEnabled just keeps skipping forever; it never disables the toggle or the timer. This is distinct from the stop-time trigger (AppViewModel+ServerControls.swift:279-284), which fires unconditionally on stop regardless of player count -- the no-players guard only applies to the recurring timer.
